UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated CubedPDF user profile and workspace preferences stored privately per user. Never stores passwords.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID matching the owning user.

userId.description: Owning user UID matching document ID and request.auth.uid.

displayName.description: Full display name shown in the CubedPDF dashboard and account menu.

email.description: Email address associated with the authenticated Firebase account (any email provider).

workspaceRole.description: Selected workspace role for tailored PDF workflows.

emailVerified.description: Whether the user's email address has been verified by Firebase Authentication.

createdAt.description: Immutable creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last modification timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

CloudRecentDoc.title: CloudRecentDoc
CloudRecentDoc.description: Synced metadata of a user's recent PDF document activity in CubedPDF.

userId.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the owning user.

fileName.description: Display filename of the PDF document.

pageCount.description: Number of pages in the document.

lastToolId.description: Identifier of the last PDF tool used on this document.

lastToolName.description: Display name of the last PDF tool used on this document.

summaryNote.description: Short summary of the last action performed.

createdAt.description: Immutable creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last modification timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: Private user account profile and workspace preferences scoped strictly to the authenticated owner.

/users/{userId}/recent_docs/{docId}.description: Private cloud-synced recent PDF document history scoped strictly to the owning user.
